text:
zoe: Final preflight: blog + webinar next Wed. We need changelog merged, docs anchors for CTAs, and a confirmed canary window. Can eng + docs land by EOD tomorrow?
mike: Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4705 - changelog at docs/changes/2026-05-12.md. Prefer canary 10:00-11:00 PT.
hana: I will add anchors for 'model-fallback' and 'dedicated-trial' and include a sample form payload. Expect docs PR in ~2h.
zoe: Anchor text to use: "Model fallback & routing" and "Start Dedicated trial" - marketing will match CTAs exactly.
mike: We'll mention fallback to smaller model variant under load and the dedicated trial flow. Ops: @release-bot please reserve slot and create rc tag.
release-bot: Canary booked: 2026-05-12T10:00:00-07:00 to 2026-05-12T11:00:00-07:00. Tag: rc/2026-05-12-launch.
omar: Growth needs final docs URL for nurture form and the sample webhook. Hana pls include contact/email snippet.
hana: Will add /docs/dedicated/trial-setup and include sample webhook + contact line. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1027
zoe: Timeline: docs + changelog merged by Tue 20:00 UTC, canary Wed 10:00-11:00 PT, public post Wed 11:30 PT, webinar Thu 17:00 UTC. Deck due Tue 16:00. Any blockers?
mike: Good from eng. If canary shows regressions we revert and push a webinar-only update.
zoe: Great 8640; I'll schedule partner pre-announce 30m before public post and update calendar.
